topic: Nine shared IPC source columns and 76.592364% overlap ratio
verified_findings: Nine exact columns are shared across five grouped predictors. Summed shared-source count is 3,228,843 versus total valid burden 4,215,620. All 9,631 valid target rows have at least one shared source observed.
inference_or_limit: 76.592364% is a ratio of summed shared component counts to summed burden, not a per-row mean, an event-level duplicate count, label reconstruction rate, or proof of mutually exclusive categories. The 9,552-row prior mask excluded 79 valid zero-burden rows; their shared contribution was observed zero.
missing_external_evidence: NCRB year-specific IPC definitions, table notes/codebooks, and rules for parent/subcategory and cross-domain case accounting, 2001?2014.

topic: Historical source availability at actual forecast origin
verified_findings: Tabular features use keyed t?1 records; sequences use same-district t?3?t?1. The availability ledger has 552 rows marked SCENARIO_UNDEFINED. Prior audits record OGD catalog dates: 2001?2012 resource 2013-09-17, 2013 resource 2014-10-16, and 2014 resource 2016-08-18.
inference_or_limit: Catalog publication metadata is not NCRB release timing, retrieval time, or evidence of forecaster access at an origin. The project has no established calendar issue date.
missing_external_evidence: Declared forecast origin plus actual NCRB release/issue records and contemporaneous retrieval/access timestamps for relevant annual resources.

topic: Duplicate district-year records and Railway conflict
verified_findings: Seven normalized-key groups (14 rows) across five cleaned files: five identical offence payloads and two conflicting 2010 Jammu & Kashmir / RAILWAYS groups (IPC and women). Existing quality rule excludes the groups from core; final model keys are unique.
inference_or_limit: Pipeline SOURCE_ROW_ID/SOURCE_RECORD_ID are not verified NCRB identifiers. Exclusion avoids inventing aggregation or selection but does not identify whether the Railway rows are distinct units, duplicates, or a mapping collision.
missing_external_evidence: Original 2010 records and stable Railway reporting-unit codes/names or official crosswalk, plus extraction provenance.

verified_findings: Audits normalize YEAR/STATE/UNIT_NAME and check within-year keys. Example: cleaned 2014 IPC has 36 states and 783 normalized names; core has 709 after filtering.
inference_or_limit: Name normalization and uniqueness do not prove same-name units denote the same geography over time. Counts alone do not prove a specific split, merger, or boundary change.
missing_external_evidence: Official dated district/state codes and 2001?2014 split, merger, rename, police-district and special-unit crosswalks.

topic: Missing values, observed zeros, partial sums and causes
verified_findings: Each stored group has 225 missing of 9,856 rows (2.282873%); these are all-sources-missing under recovered formulas. Observed zero counts range 28?781. Six formulas use sum(min_count=1), skip missing components in partial sums, preserve all-missing as missing, and match saved group values with zero mismatches. The canonical component audit has 532 source-column/year summary records.
inference_or_limit: A partial aggregate is not complete when components are missing. CRIME_DIVERSITY_INDEX has a feature-specific missing-group zero contribution, not a global zero-fill. Values do not establish why a source cell is missing.
missing_external_evidence: Original reporting forms, data dictionary/reporting notes, and extraction logs identifying non-reporting, structural inapplicability, unavailability, or extraction loss.
